html: Rhapsody of Realities is a Christian daily devotional publication by Pastor Chris Oyakhilome. It was first published January 2001 in English language and by August 2022, it was reported to have over 8,123 languages. In 2011, it distributed 2 million copies each month globally. No other material in human history has been translated into every living language. This uniquely positions Rhapsody of Realities at the center of God’s end-time agenda to reach the whole world with His Word. Join us to get these translated copies into the hands of those who need to read them.
